desc: Removes all text formatting from specified text in a single action.

name: TextSize
desc: Changes the font size of specified text to fontSize.

name: TextSizeRemove
desc: Removes all font sizes in text or the font sizeToRemove.

name: TextStyleAdd
desc: Adds the specified styles to text in a single action.

name: TextStyleRemove
desc: Removes the specified styles from text in a single action.

name: Time
desc: Returns a time result with the specified number of hours, minutes, and seconds.

name: Timestamp
desc: Returns a timestamp containing a date as a calendar date and a time as a time of day.

name: Trim
desc: Returns text stripped of all leading and trailing spaces.

name: TrimAll
desc: Returns a copy of text with specified spaces removed or inserted.

name: Truncate
desc: Returns a number truncated to the specified number of decimal places.

name: UniqueValues
desc: Returns unique values that are in a list based on the specified data type and locale.

name: Upper
desc: Returns all letters in specified text as uppercase.

name: ValueCount
desc: Returns a count of the total number of values in specified text.

name: ValueListIDs
desc: Returns a list of all value list IDs in fileName.

name: ValueListItems
desc: Returns a list of the values in a value list.

name: ValueListNames
desc: Returns a list of the names of all value lists in fileName.

name: Variance
desc: Returns the variance of a sample represented by a series of non-blank values in a field.

name: VarianceP
desc: Returns the variance of a population represented by a series of non-blank values in a field.

name: VerifyContainer
desc: Returns 0 (false) if container data was changed or deleted outside the FileMaker Platform; otherwise, returns 1 (true).

name: WeekOfYear
desc: Returns the number of weeks after January 1 of the year of a date.

name: WeekOfYearFiscal
desc: Returns a number from 1 to 53, representing the week containing a date, from a starting day.

name: While
desc: Repeats logic while the condition is true, then returns the result.

name: WindowNames
desc: Returns a list of the names of windows that are currently open.

name: WordCount
desc: Returns a count of the total number of words in specified text.

name: Year
desc: Returns a number representing the year in which a date occurs.
